verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is openly licensed is a fair openness question for a payments SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Checkout.com publishing its source under an open license: the docs describe only hosted payments and issuing products, and the probes show only an llms.txt file and no other public artifacts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
